item.text: {"decisions":[{"id":"whole-combo-attribution","verdict":"pass","reason":"Correctly ties the plugin's top-level ESM to the boot-assembled classic combo, explains whole-combo compilation failure, and identifies typert-registry as the first reported victim rather than the culprit."},{"id":"diagnosis-and-packaging","verdict":"pass","reason":"Prescribes bisecting installed bundles, a classic-script/static check, and describes the loader factory, package identity, host-provided React via require, and exported apply function."},{"id":"cross-entry-slot-registration","verdict":"partial","reason":"Correctly explains parent-owned declarations and registrant-owned fields, but gives an immediate parent/children registration instead of the required deferred slots.inject(\"settings.section\", () => register(...)) form."},{"id":"boot-restart-discipline","verdict":"pass","reason":"Accurately explains boot-only combo assembly, full host/process-tree restart, browser verification, and EADDRINUSE from an orphaned process retaining the port."},{"id":"host-and-author-prevention","verdict":"partial","reason":"Provides strong bundle attribution, validation, apply diagnostics, and restart guidance, but its author checklist repeats the incorrect immediate parent/children registration and omits deferred cross-entry slot injection."}],"caps":[{"id":"contradictory-operational-advice","triggered":true,"reason":"The report affirmatively recommends parent/children registration without slots.inject for the cross-entry slot, effectively endorsing immediate registration instead of the required deferred form."}]}
